sentences.en: The manager sat on the bench with his arms folded.
sentences.zh: 经理双臂交叉坐在长凳上。

sentences.en: The child, with sleepy eyes, was sitting on the bench.
sentences.zh: 那个眼睛惺忪的孩子坐在长凳上。

sentences.en: Some students were sitting on the bench and having lunch.
sentences.zh: 一些学生坐在长凳上吃午餐。

senses.zh: 坐在长凳上，放置长凳，在展览会上展览
